verses.saheeh: Ta, Seen, Meem.
verses.khattab: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Tā sīn mīm: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Taa seen Meem

verses.saheeh: These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.khattab: These are the verses of the clear Book
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Those, namely, these signs, are the signs of the Manifest Book, the Qur'an (the genitive annexation [āyātu’l-kitābi] conveys the [partitive] meaning of min), [the Manifest meaning] the one that manifests what is truth from what is falsehood.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kitaab e Mubeen ki aayat hain

verses.uthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّـفْسَكَ اَ لَّا يَكُوْنُوْا مُؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: la'allaka bakhi'un nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena
verses.saheeh: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
verses.khattab: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Perhaps, O Muhammad (s), you might kill yourself, out of distress for the reason, that they, namely, the people of Mecca, will not become believers (la‘alla here expresses sympathy, in other words [what is meant is] ‘have pity on it [your self] by alleviating [the burden of] this distress’).
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Muhammad), shayad tum is gham (grief) mein apni jaan kho dogey ke yeh log iman nahin latey

verses.uthmani: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنْ نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خٰضِعِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: in nasha nunazzil 'alayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat a'naquhum laha khadi'eena
verses.saheeh: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
verses.khattab: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿If We will We will send down to them a sign from the heaven before which their necks will remain (fa-zallat, [although grammatically in the past tense] is being used in the sense of the imperfect tense) bowed in humility, and they will believe (since ‘necks’ are described as ‘bowed in humility’, [a status] which in fact refers to those who possess them, the adjectival form [khādi‘ūn, ‘bowed in humility’] used therein is the one [normally] used for rational beings).
verses.romanUrdu: Hum chahein to aasmaan se aisi nishani nazil kar sakte hain ke inki gardanein iske aagey jhuk jayein

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo 'anhu mu'rideena
verses.saheeh: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
verses.khattab: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And there would never come to them from the Compassionate One any remembrance, any [revelation from the] Qur'an, that is new (muhdathin, is an explicative adjective) but that they used to disregard it.
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ke paas rehman ki taraf se jo nayi naseehat bhi aati hai yeh ussey mooh moad letey hain

verses.uthmani: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا فَسَيَأْتِيْهِمْ اَنْۢـبٰۤــؤُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.saheeh: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
verses.khattab: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily then they have denied, it; but soon there will come to them the news, the consequences, of that which they used to deride.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab ke yeh jhutla chuke hain, ankareeb inko is cheez ki haqeeqat (mukhtalif tareeqon se) maloom ho jayegi jiska yeh mazaak udatay rahey hain

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنْۢبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin
verses.saheeh: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
verses.khattab: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have they not contemplated, observed, the earth, how many We have caused to grow therein, in other words, [We have caused to grow therein] many, of every splendid kind [of vegetation], [of every] fair species.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kya inhon ne kabhi zameen par nigaah nahin daali ke humne kitni kaseer miqdaar mein har tarah ki umdah nabataat(vegetation) ismein paida ki hain

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that there is a sign, an indication of the perfection of His power, exalted be He; but most of them, in God’s knowledge, are not believers (kāna here according to Sībawayhi is extra).
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenen ismein ek nishani hai, magar in mein se aksar maanne waley nahin

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And surely your Lord, He is the Mighty One, Who will exact vengeance from the disbelievers, the Merciful, Who shows mercy to believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.uthmani: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذْ نَادٰى رَبُّكَ مُوْسٰۤى اَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena
verses.saheeh: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And, mention, O Muhammad (s), to your people, when your Lord called to Moses, on the night he saw the fire and the bush, [saying]: ‘Go to the wrongdoing folk, as a messenger,
verses.romanUrdu: Inhein us waqt ka qissa sunao jabke tumhare Rubb ne Moosa ko pukara “ zaalim qaum ke paas jaa

verses.saheeh: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
verses.khattab: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Pharaoh’s folk, to them as well as him — they wronged their souls by disbelieving in God and [wronged] the Children of Israel by enslaving them — Will they not (a-lā: the hamza indicates a negation meant as a rebuke) show fear?’, of God by being obedient to Him and affirm His Oneness?
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ki qaum ke paas, kya woh nahin darte?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ يُّكَذِّبُوْنِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
verses.khattab: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will deny me,
verses.romanUrdu: Usne arz kiya “aey Rubb, mujhey khauf hai ke woh mujhey jhutla dengey

verses.uthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَيَضِيْقُ صَدْرِىْ وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِىْ فَاَرْسِلْ اِلٰى هٰرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona
verses.saheeh: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
verses.khattab: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that anguish will constrain my breast, because of their denial of me, and that my tongue will not utter clearly, to deliver the Message, because of the knot in it. So give the Mission to, my brother, Aaron, alongside me.
verses.romanUrdu: Mera seena ghutt-ta hai aur meri zubaan nahin chalti, aap Haroon ki taraf risalat bhejein

verses.uthmani: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
verses.indopak: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنْۢبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنْ يَّقْتُلُوْنِ ۚ
verses.saheeh: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
verses.khattab: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And I have sinned against them, by my slaying of the Egyptian man, and I fear they will slay me’, for this.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mujhpar unke haan ek jurm ka ilzam bhi hai, is liye main darta hoon ke woh mujhey qatal kar dengey”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ كَلَّا ۚ فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna ma'akum mustami'oona
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
verses.khattab: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said He, exalted be He: ‘Certainly not!, they shall not slay you. Go both of you, you and your brother — this address [although in the dual form] is predominantly for the person present as opposed to the absent one — with Our signs. We will indeed be with you, hearing, what you say and what is said to you (ma‘akum: the two [Moses and Aaron] are referred to here with the plural pronoun).
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “hargiz nahin, tum dono jao hamari nishaniyan lekar, hum tumhare saath sab kuch suntey rahenge

verses.uthmani: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُوْلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fatiya fir'awna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
verses.khattab: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So the two of you approach Pharaoh and say, “Indeed We are — [indeed] each of the two of us is, the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, to you,
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ke paas jao aur ussey kaho, humko Rubb ul aalameen ne isliye bheja hai

verses.saheeh: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
verses.khattab: ˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that you should let go forth with us, to Syria, the Children of Israel” ’. So they approached him and said to him that which has been mentioned.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke tu bani Israel ko hamare saath janey de”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِيْنَا وَلِيْدًا وَّلَبِثْتَ فِيْنَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min 'umurika sineena
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
verses.khattab: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said, to Moses, ‘Did we not rear you among us, in our homes, as a child?, as an infant, only recently born but weaned, and did you not stay with us for years of your life?, for thirty years — he would dress from Pharaoh’s clothes and ride chariots of his, and was referred to as Pharaoh’s son.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “kya humne tujhko apne haan baccha sa nahin paala tha? Tu nay apni umar ke kai saal hamare haan guzare

verses.uthmani: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِىْ فَعَلْتَ وَاَنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wafa'alta fa'lataka allatee fa'alta waanta mina alkafireena
verses.saheeh: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
verses.khattab: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And you committed that deed of yours — namely, his slaying of the Egyptian — being an ingrate’, a denier of my favours to you in having reared you [among us] and not enslaved you.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur iske baad kar gaya jo kuch ke kar gaya, tu bada ehsan faramosh aadmi hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَاۤ اِذًا وَّاَنَا۠ مِنَ الضَّاۤلِّيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: qala fa'altuha ithan waana mina alddalleena
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
verses.khattab: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, ‘I did that then, when I was astray, from the knowledge and the Message which God would later give me.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne jawab diya “us waqt woh kaam maine nadanishtagi (inadvertently) mein kardiya tha

verses.uthmani: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.indopak: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِىْ رَبِّىْ حُكْمًا وَّجَعَلَنِىْ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman waja'alanee mina almursaleena
verses.saheeh: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
verses.khattab: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement, knowledge, and made me one of the messengers.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir main tumhare khauf se bhaag gaya. Iske baad mere Rubb ne mujhko hukum ata kiya aur mujhey Rasoolon mein shamil farma liya

verses.uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.indopak: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ اَنْ عَبَّدْتَّ بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: watilka ni'matun tamunnuha 'alayya an 'abbadta banee israeela
verses.saheeh: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
verses.khattab: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That is a favour with which you now reproach me that you have enslaved the Children of Israel’ (an ‘abbadta banī Isrā’īl, is explicative of tilka, ‘that’) in other words, you have enslaved them but not me: there is no favour in that, for your enslavement of them is wrong (some [scholars] have reckoned there to be an interrogative hamza of denial at the beginning of this verse [a-tilka ni‘matun, ‘is that a favour?’]).
verses.romanUrdu: Raha tera ehsan jo tu nay mujhpar jataya hai to iski haqeeqat yeh hai ke tu nay bani Israel ko ghulaam bana liya tha”

verses.saheeh: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Pharaoh said, to Moses, ‘And what is “the Lord of the Worlds” ’, the One Whose Messenger you say you indeed are? In other words: what exactly is He? And since there is no way for creation to know the true nature of God, but only to know Him through [an articulation of] His attributes, Moses, blessings and peace be upon him, responds to him with [mention of] some of these [attributes]:
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “aur yeh Rubb-ul-Aalameen kya hota hai?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۗ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
verses.khattab: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, in other words, the Creator of [all] that — should you have conviction’, that He, exalted be He, is their Creator, then believe in Him alone.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne jawab diya “Aasmano aur zameen ka Rubb, aur un sab cheezon ka Rubb jo aasmaan o zameen ke darmiyan hain, agar tum yaqeen laney waley ho.”

verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
verses.khattab: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said to those, noblemen among his folk, who were around him, ‘Did you not hear?!’, his response, how it does not correspond to the question [I asked]?
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne apne gird o pesh ke logon se kaha ‘Sunte ho?”

verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
verses.khattab: Moses added, “˹He is˺ your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, ‘Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers’. Now, even though this [fact] is comprised by what was [said] before it enrages Pharaoh, and therefore:
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha, “tumhara Rubb bhi aur tumhare un aabaa o ajdaad ka Rubb bhi jo guzar chuke hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوْلَـكُمُ الَّذِىْۤ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ
verses.transliteration: qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
verses.khattab: Pharaoh said ˹mockingly˺, “Your messenger, who has been sent to you, must be insane.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Verily this messenger of yours sent to you is a madman!’
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne ( haazirin se) kaha “ tumhare yeh Rasool sahib jo tumhari taraf bhejey gaye hain, bilkul hi pagal maloom hotay hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۗ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum ta'qiloona
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
verses.khattab: Moses responded: “˹He is˺ the Lord of the east and west, and everything in between, if only you had any sense.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, ‘The Lord of the east and the west and all that is between them — should you comprehend,’, that He is such [a Lord] then believe in Him alone.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “mashriq o magrib aur jo kuch inke darmiyan hai sabka Rubb, agar aap log kuch aqal rakhte hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَٮِٕنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلٰهًا غَيْرِىْ لَاَجْعَلَـنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُوْنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laaj'alannaka mina almasjooneena
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
verses.khattab: Pharaoh threatened, “If you take any other god besides me, I will certainly have you imprisoned.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said, to Moses: ‘If you choose any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!’. His [Pharaoh’s] prison was very harsh, for a person would be shut up [in a dungeon] underground alone, where he could neither see nor hear anyone else.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “ agar tu nay mere siwa kisi aur ko mabood maana to tujhey main un logon mein shamil kardunga jo qaid khano mein paday saddh(rotting) rahey hain”

verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
verses.khattab: Moses responded, “Even if I bring you a clear proof?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, to him: ‘What, would you do this even, if I bring you something manifest?’, patent proof of my Mission?
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “Agarche main le aaon tere saamne ek sareeh cheez bhi?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهٖۤ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.khattab: Pharaoh demanded, “Bring it then, if what you say is true.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said, to him: ‘Then bring it, if you are truthful’, in this.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “Accha to le aa agar tu saccha hai”

verses.uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: فَاَ لْقٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۚ
verses.saheeh: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
verses.khattab: So he threw down his staff and—behold!—it became a real snake
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So he threw down his staff, and lo! it was a manifest serpent, a great snake.
verses.romanUrdu: (Uski zubaan se yeh baat nikalte hi) Moosa ne apna asa (staff) phenka aur yakayak woh ek sareeh azdha (serpant/snake) tha

verses.uthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَاۤءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
verses.khattab: Then he drew his hand ˹out of his collar˺ and it was ˹shining˺ white for all to see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he drew out his hand, he brought it out of his pocket, and lo! it was white, glowing, before the onlookers, and not its usual skin colour.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir usne apna hath (bagal se) khincha aur wo sab dekne walon ke saamne chamak raha tha

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهٗۤ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۙ
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
verses.khattab: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “He is indeed a skilled magician
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said to the council around him, ‘Surely this man is a cunning sorcerer, an expert in the art of magic,
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun apne gird o pesh ke sardaron se bola “yeh shaks yaqeenan ek maahir jaadugar hai

verses.uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
verses.indopak: يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهٖ ۖ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona
verses.saheeh: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
verses.khattab: who seeks to drive you from your land by his magic. So what do you propose?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who seeks to expel you from your land by his sorcery. So what do you advise?’
verses.romanUrdu: Chahta hai ke apne jaadu ke zoar se tumko tumhare mulk se nikal de, ab tum batao tum kya hukum dete ho?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْۤا اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِى الْمَدَاۤٮِٕنِ حٰشِرِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qaloo arjih waakhahu waib'ath fee almadaini hashireena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.khattab: They replied, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch mobilizers to all cities
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Put him and his brother off for a while, postpone [judgement of] their affair, and send musterers into the cities
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “ isey aur iske bhai ko rok lijiye aur shehron mein harkare (heralds) bhej dijiye

verses.saheeh: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
verses.khattab: to bring you every skilled magician.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to bring you every cunning sorcerer’, to surpass Moses in the art of magic.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke har siyane jaadugar ko aapke paas le aayein”

verses.saheeh: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
verses.khattab: So the magicians were assembled at the set time on the appointed day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time of a known day, which was the morning of the Festival Day.
verses.romanUrdu: Chunanchey ek roz muqarrar waqt par jaadugar ikatthey karliye gaye

verses.saheeh: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
verses.khattab: And the people were asked, “Will you join the gathering
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it was said to the people, ‘Will you assemble!’
verses.romanUrdu: Aur logon se kaha gaya “tum ijtima mein chaloge

verses.uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.indopak: لَعَلَّنَا نَـتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: la'allana nattabi'u alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena
verses.saheeh: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
verses.khattab: so that we may follow the magicians if they prevail?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Maybe we will follow the sorcerers, should they be the victors’ (the interrogative [of the previous verse] is an incitement to assemble and the optative sense [implicit in la‘alla] is due to their anticipation of victory, and hence their continued adherence to their religion and rejection of Moses).
verses.romanUrdu: Shayad ke hum jaadugaron ke deen hi par reh jayein agar woh gaalib rahey”

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَٮِٕنَّ لَـنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifir'awna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena
verses.saheeh: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
verses.khattab: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, “Shall we have a ˹suitable˺ reward if we prevail?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we indeed (read a-inna either by pronouncing both hamzas, or by not pronouncing the second, but in both cases inserting an alif) have a reward if we were to be the victors?’
verses.romanUrdu: Jab jaadugar maidan mein aa gaye to unhon ne Firoun se kaha “humein inaam to milega agar hum gaalib rahey?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala na'am wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena
verses.saheeh: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
verses.khattab: He replied, “Yes, and you will then certainly be among those closest to me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Yes [of course]! And you shall then be among those closest [to me]’.

wbw.translation: the ones who are brought near."

verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “ haan, aur tum to us waqt muqarrabeen (nearest to me) mein shamil ho jaogey”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰۤى اَلْقُوْا مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ مُّلْقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona
verses.saheeh: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
verses.khattab: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you wish to cast.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Moses said to them, after they had said to him, Either you cast, or we shall be the casters [Q. 7:115]: ‘Cast what you have to cast’ — the command to do this signifies an authorisation for them to cast and a means whereby the truth will be made to prevail.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “ phenko jo tumhein phenkna hai”

verses.uthmani: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَـنَحْنُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faalqaw hibalahum wa'isiyyahum waqaloo bi'izzati fir'awna inna lanahnu alghaliboona
verses.saheeh: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
verses.khattab: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, saying, “By Pharaoh’s might, it is we who will surely prevail.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they cast their ropes and their staffs, and said, ‘By the power of Pharaoh we shall surely be the victors!’
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne fawran apni rassiyan aur laathiyan phenk di aur bole “ Firoun ke iqbal se hum hi gaalib rahenge.”

verses.uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَ لْقٰى مُوْسٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: faalqa moosa 'asahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona
verses.saheeh: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
verses.khattab: Then Moses threw down his staff, and—behold!—it devoured the objects of their illusion
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thereat Moses cast his staff and lo! it was swallowing (talqafu: one of the original two tā’ letters [of taltaqifu] has been assimilated) what they had faked, [what they had] transformed through illusion, making their ropes and staffs appear to be moving serpents.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir Moosa ne apna asa (staff) phenka to yakayak woh unke jhootey karishmon ko hadap karta chala ja raha tha

verses.saheeh: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
verses.khattab: So the magicians fell down, prostrating
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So the sorcerers fell down prostrating.
verses.romanUrdu: Ispar sarey jaadugar be-ikhtiyar sajde mein gir paday

verses.saheeh: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
verses.khattab: They declared, “We ˹now˺ believe in the Lord of all worlds—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur bol uthey ke “ maan gaye hum Rubb-ul-Aalameen ko

verses.saheeh: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verses.khattab: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the Lord of Moses and Aaron’, for they realised that what they had witnessed in the case of the staff could not have been the result of [mere] sorcery.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa aur Haroon ke Rubb ko”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَـكُمْ ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَـكَبِيْرُكُمُ الَّذِىْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ ۚ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَـكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee 'allamakumu alssihra falasawfa ta'lamoona laoqatti'anna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
verses.khattab: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic, but soon you will see. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then crucify you all.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Pharaoh said, ‘Do you believe (a-āmantum, read pronouncing both hamzas or replacing the second one with an alif) him, Moses, though I have not given you leave? He is indeed your chief, the one who has taught you sorcery — so that he only taught you some [tricks] and then surpassed you with others. Soon you will know, what I will do with you! I will assuredly cut off your hands and legs on opposite sides — in other words, the right hand of each one together with his left leg — then I shall surely crucify you all.’

wbw.translation: and I will surely crucify you

verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “tum Moosa ki baat maan gaye qabl iske ke main tumhein ijazat deta! Zaroor yeh tumhara bada hai jisne tumhein jaadu sikhaya hai. Accha, abhi tumhein maloom hua jaata hai, main tumhare haath paon mukhalif simton (opposite sides) mein katwaunga aur tum sabko sooli (crucify) chadha dunga”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona
verses.saheeh: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
verses.khattab: They responded, “˹That would be˺ no harm! Surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘There is no harm [in that], no damage will be done to us thereby. Surely to our Lord, after we die, whichever way that may be, we shall return, in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “kuch parwah nahin, hum apne Rubb ke huzur pahunch jayenge

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لَـنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰـنَاۤ اَنْ كُنَّاۤ اَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: inna natma'u an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
verses.khattab: We really hope that our Lord will forgive our sins, as we are the first to believe.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities, for being the first to believe’, in our time.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humein tawaqqu hai ke hamara Rubb hamare gunaah maaf kardega kyunke sabse pehle hum iman laye hain”

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَاَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىْۤ اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waawhayna ila moosa an asri bi'ibadee innakum muttaba'oona
verses.saheeh: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
verses.khattab: And We inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We revealed to Moses, after many years which he spent among them calling them to the truth with God’s signs but all of which only increased them in insolence, [saying], ‘Journey with My servants, the Children of Israel, by night (a variant reading [for an asri] is an isr, from the verb sarā, one form of asrā) go with them by night in the direction of the sea, for indeed you will be pursued’. Pharaoh and his armies will pursue you, but when they enter the sea in pursuit of you, I will deliver you and drown them.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Moosa ko wahee (revelation) bhejhi ke “raat o raat mere bandon ko lekar nikal jao, tumhara peecha kiya jayega”

verses.saheeh: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
verses.khattab: Then Pharaoh sent mobilizers to all cities
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then Pharaoh, having been informed of their night departure, sent to the cities — it is said that he ruled a thousand cities and twelve thousand villages — musterers, to assemble the army, saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Ispar Firoun ne (Faujein jama karne ke liye) shehron mein naqeeb (heralds) bhej diye

verses.saheeh: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
verses.khattab: ˹and said,˺ “These ˹outcasts˺ are just a handful of people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Lo! these are but a small gang. It is said that they [the Children of Israel] numbered 670,000, while his [Pharaoh’s] vanguard alone numbered 700,000 and so he deemed their number insignificant in comparison to his huge army.
verses.romanUrdu: (aur kehla bheja) ke “yeh kuch mutthi bhar log hain

verses.saheeh: And indeed, they are enraging us,
verses.khattab: who have really enraged us
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed they have enraged us, their actions infuriate us,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur inhon ne humko bahut naraaz kiya hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
verses.khattab: but we are all on the alert.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and indeed we are all on our guard’, ready (a variant reading [for hadhirūna] has hādhirūn, meaning ‘alert’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum ek aisi jamaat hain jiska shewa har waqt chokanna rehna hai”

verses.saheeh: So We removed them from gardens and springs
verses.khattab: So We lured the tyrants out of ˹their˺ gardens, springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: So We made them, Pharaoh and his folk, go forth, out of Egypt, in order to pursue Moses and his people, from gardens, orchards on either side of the Nile, and springs, streams running from the Nile through their dwellings,
verses.romanUrdu: Is tarah hum unhein unke baaghon aur chashmon (water –springs)

verses.saheeh: And treasures and honorable station -
verses.khattab: treasures, and splendid residences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and treasures, visible riches of gold and silver — these [riches] are called kunūz [as opposed to amwāl, ‘riches’] because that [portion] which is [always] due to God, exalted be He, from them had not been paid — and splendid places, exquisite residences for princes and ministers surrounded by their retinues.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur khazano aur unki behtareen qayam-gaahon se nikal laaye

verses.saheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
verses.khattab: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So [it was], that is, Our expulsion [of them] was as We have described, and We made the Children of Israel to inherit these, after drowning Pharaoh and his folk.

wbw.translation: And We caused to inherit them

verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to hua unke saath aur (dusri taraf) bani Israel ko humne in sab cheezon ka waris kardiya

verses.saheeh: So they pursued them at sunrise.
verses.khattab: And so they pursued them at sunrise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then they pursued them, they caught them up, at sunrise.
verses.romanUrdu: Subah hotey hi yeh log unke taaqub (pursuit) mein chal paday

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا تَرَاۤءَ الْجَمْعٰنِ قَالَ اَصْحٰبُ مُوْسٰۤى اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: falamma taraa aljam'ani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona
verses.saheeh: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
verses.khattab: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, ‘We have been caught!’, Pharaoh’s hosts have caught us up and we have no power against them.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab dono girohon ka aamna saamna hua to Moosa ke saathi cheekh utthey ke “ hum to pakde gaye”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ كَلَّا ۚ اِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّىْ سَيَهْدِيْنِ
verses.transliteration: qala kalla inna ma'iya rabbee sayahdeeni
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
verses.khattab: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Moses, said, ‘Certainly not!, they shall not catch us up; indeed I have my Lord with me, to provide assistance. He will guide me’, to the route of deliverance.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “ hargiz nahin mere saath mera Rubb hai, woh zaroor meri rehnumayi farmayega”

verses.uthmani: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.indopak: فَاَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى اَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۗ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib bi'asaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi al'atheemi
verses.saheeh: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
verses.khattab: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Thereupon We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff’, and he struck it, whereupon it parted, it split into twelve parts, and each part was as a mighty mountain, between each of these parts were paths which they followed, such that not even the saddles or the felts of the riders were touched by water.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Moosa ko wahee ke zariye se hukum diya ke “maar apna asa (staff) samandar par” yakayak samandar pahtt gaya aur uska har tukda ek azeem o shaan pahad ki tarah ho gaya

verses.saheeh: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
verses.khattab: We drew the pursuers to that place
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And there We brought near the others, Pharaoh and his folk, until they followed them across the same paths.
verses.romanUrdu: Usi jagah hum dusre giroh ko bhi kareeb le aaye

verses.saheeh: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
verses.khattab: and delivered Moses and those with him all together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him, by bringing them out of the sea while it was in the state mentioned [above].
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa aur un sab logon ko jo uske saath thay humne bacha liya

verses.saheeh: Then We drowned the others.
verses.khattab: Then We drowned the others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We drowned the others, Pharaoh and his folk by closing the sea on them after they had entered the sea and the Children of Israel had exited therefrom.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dusron ko garq (duba/drown) kardiya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that, drowning of Pharaoh and his folk, there is a sign, a lesson for those [generations] who would come after them; but most of them are not believers, in God. The only ones to believe were Āsiya — Pharaoh’s wife — Hizqīl, the believing man of Pharaoh’s family, and Maryam daughter of Nāmūsī, she who pointed out the bone remains of [the prophet] Joseph, peace be upon him.
verses.romanUrdu: Is waqiye mein ek nishani hai, magar in logon mein se aksar manney waley nahin hain

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And surely your Lord, He is the Mighty, for He wrought vengeance upon the disbelievers by drowning them, the Merciful, to believers, delivering them from drowning.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
verses.khattab: Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And recite to them, the disbelievers of Mecca, the tiding, the tale, of Abraham (Ibrāhīma is substituted by [the following, idh qāla, ‘when he said’])
verses.romanUrdu: Aur inhein Ibrahim ka qissa sunao

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma ta'budoona
verses.saheeh: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
verses.khattab: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when he said to his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
verses.romanUrdu: Jabke usne apne baap aur apni qaum se pucha tha ke “yeh kya cheezein hain jinko tum poojhte ho?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا نَـعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
verses.khattab: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘We worship idols — they reiterate the verb [in the response] in order to supplement it with [the following remark] — and remain cleaving to them’, we remain worshipping them all day; they give a longer response to indicate their [misplaced] pride in such [an act].
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “ kuch buth (idols/murtiyan) hain jinki hum pooja karte hain aur inhi ki sewa mein hum lagey rehte hain”

verses.saheeh: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.khattab: Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.romanUrdu: Usne pucha “kya yeh tumhari sunte hain jab tum inhein pukarte ho

verses.saheeh: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
verses.khattab: Or can they benefit or harm you?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they bring you benefit, when you worship them, or harm?, to you, if you do not?
verses.romanUrdu: Ya yeh tumhein kuch nafaa ya nuqsaan pahunchate hain?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَاۤءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُوْنَ
verses.saheeh: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
verses.khattab: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Rather, we found our fathers so doing’, that is, doing the same as we do.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “ nahin , balke humne apne baap dada ko aisa hi karte paya hai”

verses.saheeh: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
verses.khattab: Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Have you considered what you have been worshipping,
verses.romanUrdu: Ispar Ibrahim ne kaha “ kabhi tumne (aankhein khol kar) un cheezon ko dekha bhi jinki bandagi tum

verses.saheeh: You and your ancient forefathers?
verses.khattab: you and your ancestors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿you and your ancestors?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhare pichle baap dada baja latey rahey

verses.uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىْۤ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
verses.khattab: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They are indeed hateful to me, I do not worship them; but the Lord of the Worlds, I do worship Him,
verses.romanUrdu: Mere to yeh sab dushman hain, bajuz ek Rubb ul aalameen ke

verses.saheeh: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
verses.khattab: ˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[He] Who created me, it is He Who guides me, to [the proper] religion,
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne mujhey paida kiya, phir wahi meri rehnumayi farmata hai

verses.saheeh: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
verses.khattab: ˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and provides me with food and drink,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo mujhey khilata aur pilata hai

verses.saheeh: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
verses.khattab: And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when I am sick, it is He Who cures me;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab main bimar ho jaata hoon to wahi mujhey shifa deta hai

verses.saheeh: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
verses.khattab: And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who will make me die, then give me life,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo mujhey maut dega aur phir dobara mujhko zindagi bakshega

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِىْۤ اَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لِىْ خَطِۤیْــَٔـتِىْ يَوْمَ الدِّيْنِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waallathee atma'u an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni
verses.saheeh: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
verses.khattab: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who, I hope, will forgive me my iniquity on the Day of Judgement, [the Day] of Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jissey main umeed rakhta hoon ke roz e jaza mein woh meri khata maaf farmadega”

verses.uthmani: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.indopak: رَبِّ هَبْ لِىْ حُكْمًا وَّاَلْحِقْنِىْ بِالصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
verses.khattab: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, knowledge, and unite me with the righteous, the prophets.
verses.romanUrdu: (iske baad Ibrahim ne dua ki) “Aey mere Rubb, mujhey hukum ata kar aur mujhko salihon (neik logon) ke saath mila

verses.uthmani: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاجْعَلْ لِّىْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى الْاٰخِرِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
verses.khattab: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And confer on me a worthy repute, excellent praise, among posterity, those who will come after me up to the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur baad ke aane walon mein mujhko sacchi naamwari ata kar

verses.saheeh: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
verses.khattab: Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss, among those who will be given it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mujhey jannat e naeem ke warison (inheritors) mein shamil farma

verses.uthmani: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.indopak: وَاغْفِرْ لِاَبِىْۤ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّاۤلِّيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena
verses.saheeh: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
verses.khattab: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And forgive my father, for indeed he is one of those who are astray, by Your relenting to him and forgiving him: this was before it became clear to him [Abraham] that he [his father] was an enemy of God, as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a [Q. 9:114].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mere baap ko maaf karde ke beshak woh gumraah logon mein se hai

verses.saheeh: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
verses.khattab: And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And do not disgrace me, do not expose me, on the day when they, mankind, are resurrected;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mujhey us din ruswa na kar jabke sab log zinda karke uthaye jayenge

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: yawma la yanfa'u malun wala banoona
verses.saheeh: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
verses.khattab: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit
verses.jalalayn: ﻿of which [day] God, exalted be He, says [the following]: the day when neither wealth nor children will avail, anyone,
verses.romanUrdu: Jabke na maal koi faiyda dega na Aulad

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَى اللّٰهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيْمٍ ۗ
verses.transliteration: illa man ata allaha biqalbin saleemin
verses.saheeh: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
verses.khattab: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except him who comes to God with a heart that is sound, [free] from idolatry and hypocrisy — and this is the heart of the believer, whom such [things] will avail.
verses.romanUrdu: Bajuz iske ke koi shaks qalb-e-saleem (sound heart) liye huey Allah ke huzur haazir ho”

verses.saheeh: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
verses.khattab: ˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Paradise will be brought near for the God-fearing, and they will [be able to] see it,
verses.romanUrdu: (Us roz) jannat parheizgaaron ke qareeb le aayi jayegi

verses.saheeh: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
verses.khattab: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Hell will be revealed [plainly] for the perverse, the disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dozakh behke huey logon ke saamne khol di jayegi

verses.uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum ta'budoona
verses.saheeh: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
verses.khattab: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you used to worship
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unsey pucha jayega ke “ab kahan hai woh jinki tum khuda ko chodh kar ibadat karte thay

verses.uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗ هَلْ يَنْصُرُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: min dooni allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona
verses.saheeh: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
verses.khattab: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿besides God?, that is, other than Him, in the way of idols. Do they help you, by averting from you the chastisement, or do they help one another?’, by averting it from themselves? No [neither]!
verses.romanUrdu: Kya woh tumhari kuch madad kar rahey hain ya khud apna bachao kar sakte hain?”

verses.saheeh: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
verses.khattab: Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then they will be hurled, cast, into it, they and the perverse,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir woh mabood aur yeh behke huey log

verses.saheeh: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
verses.khattab: and the soldiers of Iblîs, all together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the hosts of Iblīs, his followers and those jinn and humans who were obedient to him, all together.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Iblis ke lashkar sabke sab ismein upar taley dhakeil diye jayenge

verses.saheeh: They will say while they dispute therein,
verses.khattab: There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, the perverse, shall say, as they wrangle therein, with those whom they used to worship:
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan yeh sab aapas mein jhagdenge aur yeh behke huey log (apne maboodon se) kahenge

verses.uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
verses.indopak: تَاللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنَّا لَفِىْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
verses.khattab: “By Allah! We were clearly mistaken
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘By God, we had indeed (in, softened in place of the hardened form, with its subject omitted, in other words [it would usually be] innahu) been in manifest error,
verses.romanUrdu: Ke “khuda ki kasam , hum to sareeh gumraahi mein mubtala thay

verses.saheeh: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when we equated you, in worship, with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Jabke tumko Rubb ul Aalameen ki barabari ka darja de rahey thay

verses.saheeh: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
verses.khattab: And none led us astray other than the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it was none other than the sinners, the devils or our predecessors, whose example we were following, that led us astray, from guidance.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh mujrim log hi thay jinhon ne humko is gumraahi mein dala

verses.saheeh: So now we have no intercessors
verses.khattab: Now we have none to intercede for us
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So [now] we have no intercessors, as the believers have, in the way of angels, prophets and [other] believers,
verses.romanUrdu: Ab na hamara koi sifarishi hai

verses.saheeh: And not a devoted friend.
verses.khattab: nor a close friend
verses.jalalayn: ﻿nor any sympathetic friend, who might be concerned for us.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na koi jigri dost

verses.uthmani: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَـنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena
verses.saheeh: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
verses.khattab: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿If only we had another turn, [another] return to this world, we would have been among those who believe!’ (law, ‘if only’, here is for [the conditional] optative, to which nakūna, ‘we would have been’, constitutes the response).
verses.romanUrdu: Kaash humein ek dafa phir palatne ka mauqa mil jaye to hum momin hon”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that, which is mentioned of the tale of Abraham and his people, there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan is mein ek badi nishani hai, magar in mein se aksar log iman laney waley nahin

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: The people of Noah denied the messengers
verses.khattab: The people of Noah rejected the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The people of Noah denied the messengers, by denying him, for they all brought the same message affirming God’s Oneness; or [it is] because he stayed among them for so long that it was as though he was many messengers (the feminine [person of the verb kadhdhabat, ‘denied’, governed by] qawm, ‘the people’, is on account of the import, but it is masculine on account of its [morphological] form);
verses.romanUrdu: Qaum e Nooh ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ نُوْحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona
verses.saheeh: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when Noah, their brother — [their brother only] in terms of lineage — said to them, ‘Will you not fear?, God?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jabke unke bhai Nooh ne unsey kaha tha “kya tum darte nahin ho

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly I am a trusted messenger [sent] to you, to deliver the Message with which I have been sent.
verses.romanUrdu: Main tumhare liye ek amaanat daar Rasool hoon

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me, in what I enjoin you to of God’s Oneness and obedience to Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ ۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَسْـــَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wama asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not ask of you any reward for it, for delivering it; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Main is kaam par tumse kisi ajar ka talib nahin hoon, mera ajar to Rabbul Aalameen ke zimme hai

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me."
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me’ — he repeats this [statement] for emphasis.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas tum Allah se daro aur ( be khatke) meri itaat karo”

verses.saheeh: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
verses.khattab: They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Shall we believe in you, in your words, when it is the lowliest people who follow you?’ (wa’ttaba‘aka: a variant reading has wa-atbā‘uka, ‘[when] your followers’, plural of tābi‘, ‘follower’, as a subject) the riffraff, such as the weavers and the shoemakers.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “kya hum tujhey maan lein halaanke teri pairwi razil-tareen (lowest/meanest) logon ne ikhtiyar ki hai?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِىْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
verses.khattab: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘And what do I know of what they may have been doing?
verses.romanUrdu: Nooh ne kaha “main kya jaanu ke unke amal kaise hain

verses.uthmani: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّىْ لَوْ تَشْعُرُوْنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
verses.khattab: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Their reckoning is only my Lord’s concern, and He will requite them, if only you were aware — had you known this, you would not have reviled them.
verses.romanUrdu: Unka hisaab to mere Rubb ke zimme hai, kaash tum kuch shaoor se kaam lo

verses.saheeh: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
verses.khattab: I am not going to expel the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And I am not about to drive away the believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Mera yeh kaam nahin hai ke jo iman layein unko main dhutkaar doon

verses.saheeh: I am only a clear warner."
verses.khattab: I am only sent with a clear warning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I am just a plain warner’.
verses.romanUrdu: Main to bas ek saaf saaf mutanabbeh (warn) kardene wala aadmi hoon”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا لَٮِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰـنُوْحُ لَـتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُوْمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
verses.khattab: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Lo! if you do not desist, O Noah, from what you say to us, you will assuredly be among those assailed’, with stones or curses.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “Aey Nooh , agar tu baaz na aaya to phitkarey huey logon mein shamil hokar rahega”

verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
verses.khattab: Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Noah, said, ‘My Lord, my people have denied me,
verses.romanUrdu: Nooh ne dua ki “Aey mere Rubb, meri qaum ne mujhey jhutla diya

verses.uthmani: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَّنَجِّنِىْ وَمَنْ مَّعِىَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman ma'iya mina almumineena
verses.saheeh: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
verses.khattab: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so judge conclusively between me and them, and deliver me and the believers who are with me’.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab mere aur unke darmiyan do-toak faisla karde aur mujhey aur jo momin mere saath hain inko nijaat de”

verses.uthmani: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
verses.indopak: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗ فِى الْـفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: faanjaynahu waman ma'ahu fee alfulki almashhooni
verses.saheeh: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verses.khattab: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, exalted be He, says: So We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark, [the ship] filled with humans, animals and birds.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar humne usko aur uske saathiyon ko ek bhaari hui kashti mein bacha liya

verses.saheeh: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
verses.khattab: Then afterwards We drowned the rest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then afterwards, after We delivered them, We drowned the rest, of his people.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur uske baad baaqi logon ko garq (drown) kardiya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan ismein ek nishani hai, magar inmein se aksar log maanne waley nahin

verses.indopak: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ
verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: 'Aad denied the messengers
verses.khattab: The people of ’Âd rejected the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Ād denied the messengers,
verses.romanUrdu: Aad ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ هُوْدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona
verses.saheeh: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when Hūd, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jabke unke bhai Hood ne unse kaha tha “kya tum darte nahin

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly I am a trusted messenger [sent] to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Main tumhare liye ek amaanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ ۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَسْــَٔـلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wama asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Main is kaam par tumse kisi ajar ka talib nahin hoon, mera ajar to Rabbul Aalameen ke zimme hai

verses.saheeh: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
verses.khattab: ˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do you build on every prominence, every high place, a monument, an edifice as a signpost for passers-by, so that you may hurl abuse?, at those who pass by you and deride them (ta‘bathūna, is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of [the verb] tabnūna, ‘you build’).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh tumhara kya haal hai ke har unchey maqaam par la haasil ek yaadgaar imarat bana daalte ho

verses.saheeh: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
verses.khattab: and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And you set up structures, for [extracting] water underground, that perhaps you might, as though you will, last forever, therein and not die.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur baday baday qasar (huge castles) taamir karte ho goya tumhein hamesha rehna hai

verses.saheeh: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
verses.khattab: and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when you assault, to smite or slay, you assault like tyrants, mercilessly!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab kisi par haath daalte ho jabbar ban kar daalte ho

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God, in this, and obey me, in what I have commanded you.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas tum log Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.saheeh: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
verses.khattab: Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And fear Him Who has provided you, Who has been gracious to you, in a way that you know,
verses.romanUrdu: Daro ussey jisne woh kuch tumhein diya hai jo tum jaante ho

verses.saheeh: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
verses.khattab: He provided you with cattle, and children
verses.jalalayn: ﻿provided you with cattle and sons,
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhein jaanwar diye, auladein di

verses.saheeh: And gardens and springs.
verses.khattab: and gardens, and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and gardens, orchards, and springs, rivers.
verses.romanUrdu: Baagh diye aur chashme(water-springs) diye

verses.uthmani: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.indopak: اِنِّىْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۗ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.khattab: I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of a tremendous day’, in this world and in the Hereafter should you disobey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Mujhey tumhare haqq mein ek baday din ke azaab ka darr hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْنَاۤ اَوَعَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْوٰعِظِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qaloo sawaon 'alayna awa'athta am lam takun mina alwa'itheena
verses.saheeh: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
verses.khattab: They responded, “It is all the same to us whether you warn ˹us˺ or not
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘It is the same to us whether you admonish [us] or are not one of those who admonish, anyway. In other words, we will not heed your admonition.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawaab diya “ tu naseehat kar ya na kar, hamare liye yaksan hai

verses.saheeh: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
verses.khattab: This is simply the tradition of our predecessors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, that you threaten us with, is merely the fabrication of the ancients, that is, their inventions and lies (a variant reading [for khalq, ‘fabrication’] is khuluq, ‘ethos’, in other words, this denial of resurrection to which we adhere is merely ‘the ethos of the ancients’, in other words, their nature and wont);
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh baatein to yunhi hoti chali aayi hain

verses.saheeh: And we are not to be punished."
verses.khattab: And we will never be punished.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and we will not be chastised’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum azaab mein mubtala honay walay nahin hain”

verses.uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَهْلَـكْنٰهُمْ ۗ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they denied him, concerning the chastisement, whereupon We destroyed them, in this world with the [barren] wind [cf. Q. 51:41]. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar unhon ne usey jhutla diya aur humne unko halaak kardiya. Yaqeenan ismein ek nishani hai, magar inmein se aksar log maanne waley nahin hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: Thamud denied the messengers
verses.khattab: The people of Thamûd rejected the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thamūd denied the messengers,
verses.romanUrdu: Samood ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona
verses.saheeh: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: when their brother Ṣâliḥ said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when Sālih, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you fear God?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jabke unke bhai Saleh ne unse kaha “kya tum darte nahin

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: Truly I am a trusted messenger [sent] to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Main tumhare liye ek amaanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ ۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَسْــَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wama asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Main is kaam par tumse kisi ajar ka talib nahin hoon, mera ajar to Rabbul aalameen ke zimme hai

verses.saheeh: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
verses.khattab: Do you think you will be ˹forever˺ left secure in what you have here
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Will you be left secure in that which is here, of good things —
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum un sab cheezon ke darmiyan, jo yahan hain, bas yunhi itminaan se rehne diye jaogey

verses.saheeh: Within gardens and springs
verses.khattab: amid gardens and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿amid gardens and springs,
verses.romanUrdu: In baaghon (gardens) aur chasmon mein

verses.saheeh: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
verses.khattab: and ˹various˺ crops, and palm trees ˹loaded˺ with tender fruit
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and farms and date palms with slender, delicate and tender, spathes?
verses.romanUrdu: In kheton aur nakhlistano (date-groves) mein jinke khosey rass bharey hain

verses.saheeh: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
verses.khattab: to carve homes in the mountains with great skill
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And you hew dwellings out of the mountains arrogantly (a variant reading [of farihīna, ‘arrogant’] has fārihīn, ‘skilfully’).
verses.romanUrdu: Tum pahad khodh khodh kar fakhariya (proudly) un mein imaratein banate ho

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me, in what I have commanded you,
verses.romanUrdu: Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.saheeh: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
verses.khattab: And do not follow the command of the transgressors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and do not obey the command of the prodigal,
verses.romanUrdu: Un bay-lagaam logon ki itaat na karo

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيْنَ يُفْسِدُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona
verses.saheeh: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
verses.khattab: who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who cause corruption in the earth, through acts of disobedience, and act righteously’, by being obedient to God.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo zameen mein fasaad barpa karte hain aur koi islaah nahin karte”

verses.saheeh: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
