verses.khattab: They replied, “You are simply bewitched
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched, those who have succumbed so many times to sorcery that their minds have been overcome.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “tu mehaz ek sehar-zadah (affected by magic) aadmi hai

verses.uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: مَاۤ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُـنَا ۙ فَأْتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.saheeh: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.khattab: You are only a human being like us, so bring forth a sign if what you say is true.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And, moreover, you are just a human being like us. So bring [us] a sign, if you are sincere’, in your Mission.
verses.romanUrdu: Tu hum jaise ek Insaan ke siwa aur kya hai, laa koi nishani agar tu saccha hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
verses.indopak: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَـكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin ma'loomin
verses.saheeh: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
verses.khattab: Ṣâliḥ said, “Here is a camel. She will have her turn to drink as you have yours, each on an appointed day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink, a share of the water, and you shall drink [each] on a known day.
verses.romanUrdu: Saleh ne kaha “yeh ountni (she-camel) hai ek din iske peene ka hai aur ek din tum sab ke pani lenay ka

verses.uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
verses.saheeh: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.khattab: And do not ever touch her with harm, or you will be overtaken by the torment of a tremendous day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by the chastisement of an awful day’, [awful] because of the awfulness of the chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Isko hargiz na chedhna(molest) warna ek baday din ka azaab tumko aa lega”

verses.saheeh: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
verses.khattab: But they killed her, becoming regretful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they hamstrung her — a group of them hamstrung her with the approval of others; and then became remorseful, for having hamstrung it.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar unhon ne iski kunchein kaat di (hamstrung her) aur aakhir-e-kaar pachtate reh gaye

verses.uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faakhathahumu al'athabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they were seized by the chastisement, which had been promised and were destroyed. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Azaab ne unhein aa liya, yaqeenan ismein ek nishani hai, magar in mein se aksar maanne waley nahin

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.khattab: The people of Lot rejected the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The people of Lot denied the messengers,
verses.romanUrdu: Lut ki qaum ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ لُوْطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona
verses.saheeh: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when Lot, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jabke unke bhai Lut ne unsey kaha tha “kya tum darte nahin

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly I am a trusted messenger [sent] to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Main tumhare liye ek amanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ ۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَسْــَٔـلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wama asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not ask of you any reward for this; my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Main is kaam par tumse kisi ajar ka talib nahin hoon, mera ajar to Rabbul aalameen ke zimme hai

verses.saheeh: Do you approach males among the worlds
verses.khattab: Why do you ˹men˺ lust after fellow men
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What! Of all people you come unto males [to fornicate],
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum duniya ki makhlooq mein se Mardon ke paas jatey ho

verses.uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ تَذَرُوْنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَـكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْ ۗ بَلْ اَنْـتُمْ قَوْمٌ عٰدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun 'adoona
verses.saheeh: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
verses.khattab: leaving the wives that your Lord has created for you? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and forsake the wives your Lord has created for you?, in other words, [you forsake intimacy with] their front parts? Nay, but you are a transgressing folk’, overstepping [the bounds of] what is lawful into what is unlawful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhari biwiyon mein tumhare Rubb ne tumhare liye jo kuch paida kiya hai usey chodh detey ho? Balke tum log to hadd se hi guzar gaye ho.”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا لَٮِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰلُوْطُ لَـتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
verses.khattab: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be expelled.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘If you do not desist, O Lot, from reproaching us, you will assuredly be of those expelled’, from our land.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “ aey Lut” agar tu in baaton se baaz na aaya to jo log hamari bastiyon se nikale gaye hain unmein tu bhi shamil ho kar rahega”

verses.saheeh: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
verses.khattab: Lot responded, “I am truly one of those who despise your ˹shameful˺ practice
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Lot, said, ‘Truly I abhor, I detest, what you do.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “tumhare kartooton par jo log kudd (abhor/detest) rahey hain main un mein shamil hoon

verses.saheeh: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
verses.khattab: My Lord! Save me and my family from ˹the consequences of˺ what they do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My Lord, deliver me and my family from what they do’, that is, from the punishment for it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey parwardigar, mujhey aur mere ehal-o-ayaal (me and my people/ my family) ko inki badkirdariyon se nijaat de”

verses.saheeh: So We saved him and his family, all,
verses.khattab: So We saved him and all of his family
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We delivered him and all his family,
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar humne usey aur uske sab ehal-o-ayaal ko bacha liya

verses.saheeh: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
verses.khattab: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except an old woman — his wife — among those who stayed behind, whom We destroyed.
verses.romanUrdu: Bajuz ek budiya ke jo peechey reh janey walon mein se thi

verses.saheeh: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.khattab: Then We utterly destroyed the rest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We destroyed [all] the others,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir baaqi maanda(rest) logon ko humne tabaah kardiya

verses.uthmani: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًا ۚ فَسَاۤءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.khattab: pouring upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We rained on them a rain, [We rained on them] stones — this [detail] pertains to [the previous] statement concerning their destruction — and evil was, their rain, the rain of those who were warned!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unpar barsayi ek barsaat, badi hi buri baarish thi jo un daraye janey walon par nazil hui

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan ismein ek nishani hai, magar inmein se aksar maanne waley nahin

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
verses.khattab: The residents of the Forest rejected the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The dwellers in the wood (a variant reading [for ashābu’l-aykati] has ashābu laykata), a thicket of trees near Midian, denied the messengers,
verses.romanUrdu: Ashaab-ul-Aiyqah ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala lahum shu'aybun ala tattaqoona
verses.saheeh: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when Shu‘ayb — He [God] does not say ‘their brother’ [in this instance] because he [Shu‘ayb] was not [in terms of lineage] one of them — said to them, ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jabke Shoaib ne unse kaha tha “kya tum darte nahin

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly I am a trusted messenger [sent] to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Main tumhare liye ek amanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So fear God and obey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ ۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَسْـَٔـــلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wama asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not ask of you any reward for this; indeed my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Main is kaam par tumse kisi ajar ka talib nahin hoon, mera ajar to Rabbul aalameen ke zimme hai

verses.uthmani: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
verses.indopak: ۞ اَوْفُوا الْـكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena
verses.saheeh: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
verses.khattab: Give full measure, and cause no loss ˹to others˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Give full measure and do not be of those who give short measure,
verses.romanUrdu: Paimane theek bharo (Give full measure) aur kisi ko ghaata (less) na do

verses.saheeh: And weigh with an even balance.
verses.khattab: Weigh with an even balance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and weigh with an even balance,
verses.romanUrdu: Saheeh tarazu se tolo

verses.uthmani: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَاۤءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala ta'thaw fee alardi mufsideena
verses.saheeh: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
verses.khattab: and do not defraud people of their property. Nor go about spreading corruption in the land
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and do not defraud people in their goods, do not diminish anything of what is due to them, and do not be degenerate in the earth, seeking corruption, by killing or otherwise ([ta‘thaw, ‘degenerate’] derives from ‘athiya, meaning afsada, ‘to corrupt’; mufsidīna, ‘seeking corruption’, is a circumstantial qualifier emphasising the import of its operator [ta‘thaw]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur logon ko unki cheezein kam na do, zameen mein fasaad na phaylate phiro

verses.saheeh: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
verses.khattab: And fear the One Who created you and ˹all˺ earlier peoples.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And fear Him Who created you and the former generations’, [all] creation [before you].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us zaat ka khauff karo jisne tumhein aur guzishta nasalon ko paida kiya hai.”

verses.saheeh: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.khattab: They replied, “You are simply bewitched
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “tu mehaz ek sehar zadah(affected by magic) aadmi hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُـنَا وَ اِنْ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena
verses.saheeh: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
verses.khattab: Also, you are only a human being like us, and we think you are indeed a liar
verses.jalalayn: ﻿You are just a human being like us. And we indeed (in, softened in place of the hardened form, its subject omitted, in other words [it would be] innahu) think that you are one of the liars.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tu kuch nahin magar ek Insaan hum hi jaisa, aur hum to tujhey bilkul jhoota samajhte hain

verses.uthmani: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: faasqit 'alayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.saheeh: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.khattab: So cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if what you say is true.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then make fragments (read kisfan or kisafan) of the heaven fall upon us, if you are of the truthful’, in your Mission.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar tu saccha hai to humpar aasmaan ka koi tukda gira de”

verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
verses.khattab: Shu’aib responded, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing’, and will requite you for it.
verses.romanUrdu: Shoaib ne kaha “ mera Rubb jaanta hai jo kuch tum kar rahey ho”

verses.uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.indopak: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: fakaththaboohu faakhathahum 'athabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana 'athaba yawmin 'atheemin
verses.saheeh: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
verses.khattab: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ were overtaken by the torment of the day of the ˹deadly˺ cloud. That was really a torment of a tremendous day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they denied him, so they were seized by the chastisement of the day of the shade (al-zulla) — a cloud which gave them shade when they suffered a bout of extreme heat but which then rained down fire on them and they were incinerated. Assuredly it was the chastisement of a tremendous day.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne usey jhutla diya, aakhir-e-kaar chatri waley din (Day of Canopy) ka azaab unpar aa gaya, aur woh baday hi khauf-naak din ka azaab tha

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan ismein ek nishani hai, magar in mein se aksar log maanne waley nahin

verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely your Lord, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb zabardast bhi hai aur raheem bhi

verses.saheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: This is certainly a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly it, the Qur'an, is the revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh Rabbul Aalameen ki nazil karda cheez hai

verses.saheeh: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
verses.khattab: which the trustworthy spirit ˹Gabriel˺ brought down
verses.jalalayn: ﻿brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit, Gabriel,
verses.romanUrdu: Isey lekar tere dil par amanat-daar rooh utri hai

verses.saheeh: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
verses.khattab: into your heart ˹O Prophet˺—so that you may be one of the warners—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿upon your heart, that you may be [one] of the warners,
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke tu un logon mein shamil ho jo (khuda ki taraf se khalq-e-khuda ko) mutanabbeh (warn) karne waley hain

verses.saheeh: In a clear Arabic language.
verses.khattab: in a clear Arabic tongue
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in a clear Arabic tongue (a variant reading [for nazala, ‘he brought down’, verse 193] has nuzzila, ‘was sent down’, and al-rūha, ‘the Spirit’, in the accusative, the subject of the verb being God).
verses.romanUrdu: Saaf saaf arabi zubaan mein

verses.saheeh: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
verses.khattab: And it has indeed been ˹foretold˺ in the Scriptures of those before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly it, the allusion to the Qur'an [that would be] revealed to Muhammad (s), is in the Scriptures, the Books, of the ancients, such as the Torah and the Gospel.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur agley logo ki kitaabon mein bhi yeh maujood hai

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ اٰيَةً اَنْ يَّعْلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰۤؤُا بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: awalam yakun lahum ayatan an ya'lamahu 'ulamao banee israeela
verses.saheeh: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
verses.khattab: Was it not sufficient proof for the deniers that it has been recognized by the knowledgeable among the Children of Israel
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is it not a sign, of this fact, for them, for the disbelievers of Mecca, that the learned of the Children of Israel recognise it?, [those] such as ‘Abd Allāh b. Salām and his companions, from among those who became [Muslim] believers: they are able inform [you] of this (read yakun with āyatan in the accusative, or takun with āyatun in the nominative).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya in (ehle Makkah) ke liye yeh koi nishani nahin hai ke isey ulema-e-bani Israel jaante hain

verses.saheeh: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
verses.khattab: Had We revealed it to a non-Arab
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For had We revealed it to some non-Arabs (a‘jamūn is the plural of a‘jam),
verses.romanUrdu: (Lekin inki hatdarmi ka haal yeh hai ke) agar hum isey kisi ajami (non-arab) par bhi nazil kar detey

verses.uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيْهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۗ
verses.saheeh: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
verses.khattab: who would then recite it to the deniers ˹in fluent Arabic˺, still they would not have believed in it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and had he recited it to them, that is, [to] the disbelievers of Mecca, they would not have believed in it, disdaining to follow it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh (faseeh arabi kalaam) woh inko padh kar sunata tab bhi yeh maan kar na detey

verses.saheeh: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.khattab: This is how We allow denial ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, in the same way in which We would have caused denial of it to penetrate [the hearts of disbelievers] had it been recited by a non-Arab, We have caused, denial of, it to penetrate the hearts of the criminals, the Meccan disbelievers, when Muhammad (s) recites it.
verses.romanUrdu: Isi tarah humne is (zikr) ko mujrimon ke dilon mein guzara hai

verses.uthmani: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
verses.indopak: لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰى يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: la yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo al'athaba alaleema
verses.saheeh: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
verses.khattab: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will not believe in it until they behold the painful chastisement,
verses.romanUrdu: Woh ispar iman nahin latey jab tak azaab e aleem na dekh lein

verses.saheeh: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
verses.khattab: which will take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that it will come upon them suddenly while they are not aware.

wbw.translation: And it will come to them

verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab woh be-khabari mein unpar aa padta hai

verses.saheeh: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
verses.khattab: Then they will cry, “Can we be allowed more time?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thereupon they will say, ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’, that we might become believers?; and it shall be said to them, ‘No!’, and they will say, ‘When will this chastisement be?’ God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt kehte hain “ke kya ab humein kuch mohalat mil sakti hai?”

verses.saheeh: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.khattab: Do they ˹really˺ seek to hasten Our torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So do they [seek to] hasten Our chastisement?

wbw.translation: So is it for Our punishment

verses.romanUrdu: To kya yeh log hamare azab ke liye jaldi macha rahey hain

verses.saheeh: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
verses.khattab: Imagine ˹O Prophet˺ if We allowed them enjoyment for years
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Consider [this] then — inform Me: If We were to let them enjoy [life] for [many] years,
verses.romanUrdu: Tumne kuch gaur kiya , agar hum inhein barason tak aish karne ki mohalat bhi de dein

verses.saheeh: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
verses.khattab: then there came to them what they had been threatened with
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then there were to come on them that which they have been promised, of chastisement,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur phir wahi cheez unpar aa jaye jissey inhein daraya jaa raha hai

verses.uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.indopak: مَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يُمَتَّعُوْنَ ۗ
verses.saheeh: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
verses.khattab: would that enjoyment be of any benefit to them ˹at all˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in what way (mā here is interrogative) would that enjoyment which they were given avail them?, in averting the chastisement or mitigating it? It would be of no avail!
verses.romanUrdu: To woh saamaan-e-zeist (provisions of life) jo unko mila hua hai inke kis kaam aayega

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُوْنَ ۖ
verses.transliteration: wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona
verses.saheeh: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
verses.khattab: We have never destroyed a society without warners
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We have not destroyed any town but it had warners, messengers to warn its inhabitants;
verses.romanUrdu: (Dekho) humne kabhi kisi basti ko iske bagair halaak nahin kiya ke uske liye khabardar karne waley haqq e naseehat ada karne ko maujood thay

verses.saheeh: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
verses.khattab: to remind ˹them˺, for We would never wrong ˹anyone˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as a reminder, an admonition for them; for We were never unjust, for We destroy them [only] after they have been warned. The following was revealed to refute what the idolaters were saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum zaalim na thay

verses.saheeh: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
verses.khattab: It was not the devils who brought this ˹Quran˺ down
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It, the Qur'an, has not been brought down by the devils.
verses.romanUrdu: Is (kitaab e mubeen) ko shayateen lekar nahin utray hain

verses.saheeh: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
verses.khattab: it is not for them ˹to do so˺, nor can they
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Neither would it behove, befit, them, to bring it down, nor are they capable, [of doing] that.
verses.romanUrdu: Na yeh kaam unko sajta hai, aur na woh aisa kar hi sakte hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
verses.khattab: for they are strictly barred from ˹even˺ overhearing ˹it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly they are barred, restrained with blazing stars, from the hearing, of the sayings of the angels.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh to iski samaat (hearing) tak se door rakkhey gaye hain

verses.uthmani: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: fala tad'u ma'a allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almu'aththabeena
verses.saheeh: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
verses.khattab: So do not ever call upon any other god besides Allah, or you will be one of the punished
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So do not invoke any other god with God, lest you be among the chastised — if you were to do what they call you to.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas (aey Muhammad), Allah ke saath kisi dusre mabood ko na pukaro, warna tum bhi saza paaney walon mein shamil ho jaogey

verses.saheeh: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
verses.khattab: And warn ˹all, starting with˺ your closest relatives
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And warn the nearest of your kinsfolk, namely, the Banū Hāshim and the Banū al-Muttalib: ‘He [the Prophet] warned them publicly …’, as reported by al-Bukhārī and Muslim.
verses.romanUrdu: Apne qareeb-tareen rishtedaaron ko darao

verses.uthmani: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waikhfid janahaka limani ittaba'aka mina almumineena
verses.saheeh: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
verses.khattab: and be gracious to the believers who follow you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And lower your wing, show your gentle side, to the believers, the affirmers of God’s Oneness, who follow you.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur iman laney walon mein se jo log tumhari pairwi ikhtiyar karein unke saath tawazo (humble/kindness) se pesh aao

verses.uthmani: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّىْ بَرِىْۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: fain 'asawka faqul innee bareeon mimma ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
verses.khattab: But if they disobey you, say, “I am certainly free of what you do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But if they, your kinsfolk, disobey you, say, to them: ‘I am absolved of what you do’, in worshipping [gods] other than God.
verses.romanUrdu: Lekin agar woh tumhari nafarmaani karein to unsey kehdo ke jo kuch tum karte ho ussey main bari-uz-zimma (not responsible) hoon

verses.saheeh: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.khattab: Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And put your trust (wa-tawakkal, or read fa-tawakkal, ‘then put your trust’) in the Mighty, the Merciful, God, in other words, entrust Him with all your affairs,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us zabardast aur raheem par tawakkul(bharosa) karo

verses.saheeh: Who sees you when you arise
verses.khattab: Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who sees you when you stand, for prayer,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo tumhein us waqt dekh raha hota hai jab tum uthte ho

verses.saheeh: And your movement among those who prostrate.
verses.khattab: as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and your movements — in [performing] the [various] parts of prayer: standing, sitting, bowing and prostrating — among those who prostrate, those who perform the prayers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur sajda guzaar logon mein tumhari naqal o harakat par nigaah rakhta hai

verses.saheeh: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.khattab: He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh sab kuch sunnay aur jaanne wala hai

verses.uthmani: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.indopak: هَلْ اُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلٰى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰـطِيْنُ ۗ
verses.saheeh: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verses.khattab: Shall I inform you of whom the devils ˹actually˺ descend upon
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Shall I inform you, O disbelievers of Mecca, upon whom the devils descend? (tanazzalu: one of the tā’ letters in the original [tatanazzalu] has been omitted).
verses.romanUrdu: Logon, kya main tumhein bataon ke shayateen kis par utra karte hain

verses.saheeh: They descend upon every sinful liar.
verses.khattab: They descend upon every sinful liar
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They descend upon every sinful, profligate, liar, such as Musaylama and other soothsayers.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh har chaal saaz, badhkaar par utra karte hain

verses.saheeh: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
verses.khattab: who gives an ˹attentive˺ ear ˹to half-truths˺, mostly passing on sheer lies
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, the devils, report the heard [sayings], what they hear from the angels [they report] to the soothsayers, but most of them are liars, adding much that is false to what they hear — this was [revealed] before the devils were barred from the heaven.
verses.romanUrdu: Suni sunayi baatein kaano mein phoonkte hain, aur unmein se aksar jhootey hotay hain

verses.saheeh: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
verses.khattab: As for poets, they are followed ˹merely˺ by deviants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them, in their poetry, propounding it and reciting it on their behalf to others; they are thus reprehensible.
verses.romanUrdu: Rahey shuaraa (poets), to unke peechey behke huey log chala karte hain

verses.uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.indopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِىْ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيْمُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona
verses.saheeh: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
verses.khattab: Do you not see how they rant in every field
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have you not noticed that — are you not aware that — in every valley, of the valleys of rhetoric and the art thereof, they rove, overstepping the bounds [of decency] in [their] eulogies and diatribes,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum dekhte nahin ho ke woh har waadi (valley) mein bhatakte hain

verses.saheeh: And that they say what they do not do? -
verses.khattab: only saying what they never do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that they say, we do, what they do not do?, in other words, that they lie.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aisi baatein kehte hain jo karte nahin hain

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ ۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّانْتَصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا ۗ وَسَيَـعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْۤا اَىَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَّـنْقَلِبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: illa allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati wathakaroo allaha katheeran waintasaroo min ba'di ma thulimoo wasaya'lamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona
verses.saheeh: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
verses.khattab: Except those who believe, do good, remember Allah often, and ˹poetically˺ avenge ˹the believers˺ after being wrongfully slandered. The wrongdoers will come to know what ˹evil˺ end they will meet
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Save those, poets, who believe and perform righteous deeds and remember God frequently, in other words, [those whom] poetry does not distract from the remembrance [of God], and vindicate themselves, by lampooning the disbelievers, after they have been wronged, by the disbelievers’ reviling of them [as belonging] together with all believers — such [individuals] are not reprehensible. God, exalted be He, says: God does not like the utterance of evil words out loud, unless a person has been wronged [Q. 4:148]; He, exalted be He, also says: so whoever commits aggression against you, commit aggression against him in the manner that he committed against you [Q. 2:194]; and those, poets and others, who are wrongdoers will soon know the reversal, the return, with which they will meet, [by which] they will return, after death.
verses.romanUrdu: Bajuz un logon ke jo iman laye aur jinhon ne neik amal kiye aur Allah ko kasrat se yaad kiya aur jab unpar zulm kiya gaya to sirf badla le liye, aur zulm karne walon ko anqareeb maloom ho jayega ke woh kis anjaam se do-chaar hotay hain
